config.arm: ARM Z: random-init + KITTI only, 200 epochs, downsample_levels=3 + num_disparities=24 (stride 1/8, 8px spacing, range 184px) + cost_volume_shift=right + regression_normalize=True + per-pixel L2-normalized features
config.intervention: per-pixel L2 unit-normalization of L/R features before shift-right subtraction: Lhat = L / max(||L||_2, 1e-5), Rhat = R / max(||R||_2, 1e-5), norm over 32-channel axis, then existing subtract cost volume; +0 parameters
config.split_enforcement: train_base split='hailo_calib' only; no hailo_val sample enters optimizer loop
config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
config.augmentation: random crop, independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip
config.known_deviation: no batch normalisation (BN-folded exported artifact), carried into all arms
